notes: Alaska's All-State choirs are run by the Alaska School Activities Association (ASAA) — the state's high school activities governing body — as part of the ASAA/First National Bank Alaska All-State Music Festival, NOT by the Alaska Music Educators Association (AMEA), which is credited only as a supporter. Two choral ensembles: All-State Mixed Choir and All-State Treble Choir (alongside All-State Band and All-State Orchestra). ASAA labels the season by the fall festival year ("2026 All-State Music Festival", November 19-21, 2026), which falls in the 2026-27 school year. IMPORTANT: at retrieval the DEADLINES tab was updated for 2026 but the AUDITIONS tab still showed 2025 audition materials, 2025 audition open/close dates, and 2025 guest conductors; those stale 2025 items are deliberately NOT recorded here as 2026-27 data. The linked music handbook was still the 2025-26 edition.

organization.name: Alaska School Activities Association
organization.description: The Alaska School Activities Association governs interscholastic activities for Alaska high schools, including the annual ASAA/First National Bank Alaska All-State Music Festival. The ASAA Music Coordinator administers All-State Band, Choir, Treble Choir and Orchestra auditions, registration and the Gala Performance Concert.

programs.name: All-State Mixed Choir
programs.description: One of two choral ensembles of the ASAA/First National Bank Alaska All-State Music Festival. The 2026 festival is hosted by Bartlett and West Anchorage High Schools and ASAA, with rehearsals at Bartlett High School, dress rehearsals at West Anchorage High School, and a Gala Performance Concert at West Anchorage High School.

requirements.title: Recorded audition submitted through the Opus platform
requirements.description: All-State auditions are submitted online through the Opus platform; directors contact ASAA Music Coordinator Barb Carroll (barb@asaa.org) for information on how to upload auditions.

requirements.title: Choir audition must include the Chorale
requirements.description: ASAA states choir auditions must include the Chorale, with materials and part-singing tracks distributed via the ASAA website or a linked Google Drive folder. Only the 2025 edition of those materials was posted at retrieval.

requirements.title: Student eligibility waiver and eligibility review
requirements.description: Schools must submit a Student Eligibility Waiver for ASAA Music Festival Participation and report through the School Activities Reporting System (SARS). ASAA states failure to meet deadlines can result in students becoming ineligible to participate.

requirements.title: Festival dress code
requirements.description: November 19-20, 2026 (rehearsals): students follow the Bartlett High School dress code. November 21, 2026 (dress rehearsal and concert): students wear their school's formal concert uniform; if the school has no formal concert uniform, students wear all black floor-length dress, skirts, or pants.
